post.topic: Automated Abandoned Cart Recovery via WhatsApp for E-commerce Stores
post.headline: Stop Losing Revenue to *Abandoned Carts*
post.subline: Automatically recover lost sales by sending timely, personalized WhatsApp messages when shoppers leave checkout.
post.caption:
Nearly 70% of online shoppers leave their carts without purchasing.

Standard recovery emails get buried in spam folders while potential buyers forget their cart.

An automated WhatsApp workflow triggers 15 minutes after abandonment. It greets the customer, answers quick sizing or shipping questions, and delivers a direct 1-click checkout link.

Practical tip for today: Check your current cart recovery open rates and set up a prompt SMS or instant message follow-up within 30 minutes of checkout drop-off.

Save this post and share it with an e-commerce store owner who wants to recover lost sales.

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call
post.insight_note: E-commerce store owners frequently lose high-intent buyers at checkout, and automated WhatsApp follow-ups dramatically outperform traditional email recovery rates.
